paragraphs: Yishmael. Mar bar Yishmael (this requires examination). Ulla bar Yishmael. Rava bar Yishmael. [Glosses: Yishmael. (a) Ketubbot (7a): R. Yishmael ben Yaakov of Tyre; in my opinion it should read R. Shimon ben Yaakov. (b) Kiddushin (54a): R. Yishmael son of R. Yitzḥak; I think it should read R. Shemuel ben Yitzḥak; not corrected. (c) Niddah (20, end of side b), in שס״ח [provisionally the new Shas]: R. Yishmael son of R. Yosef; in my opinion it should read Yose.]
